 THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO QUASH PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION DATED 12.12.2006,
BEARING NO. LAQ(6)CR 434/2005-06 ISSUED BY THE RESPONDENT NO.2 AUTHORITY AT ANNEXURE-A TO THE WRIT PETITION IN SO FAR AS SCHEDULE PROPERTY BELONGING TO THE PETITIONERS IS CONCERNED OR ISSUE A WRIT IN THE NATURE OF DECLARATION OR ANY APPROPRIATE WRIT OR ORDER OR DIRECTION, DECLARING THAT THE LAND ACQUISITION PROCEEDINGS INITIATED BY ISSUANCE OF PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION DATED 12.12.2006, BEARING NO. LAQ(6)CR 434/2005-06 BY THE RESPONDENT NO.2 AUTHORITY AT ANNEXURE-A TO THE WRIT PETITION HAS LAPSED BY VIRTUE OF COMING IN TO FORCE OF THE RIGHT TO FAIR COMPENSATION ADN TRANSPARENCY IN LAND ACQUISITION, REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT ACT,
2013 IN SO FAR AS SCHEDULE LAND BELONGING TO THE PETITIONERS IS CONCERNED.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:

In this writ petition, petitioner is assailing the Preliminary Notification dated 12.12.2006 (Annexure-A) passed by respondent No.2.
2.

sentences.text: It is the grievance of the petitioner that though the Preliminary Notification has been passed by the respondent - authorities to acquire the schedule property for the purpose of formation of Shantaveri Gopalagowdanagara II Stage extension at Mysuru, however the same has not reached to its logical end by respondent - authorities.

In this regard, Sri. T.P. Vivekananda, learned counsel for respondent Nos.2 and 3 submitted that the petitioner herein is the subsequent purchaser after the issuance of the Preliminary Notification dated 12.12.2006.
4.

In that view of the matter, considering the factual aspects on record that the respondent - authorities have not taken NC: 2024:KHC:45580 further steps pursuant to the Preliminary Notification issued, and also taking into consideration that the petitioner herein is the subsequent purchaser and same would not come in the way of granting relief as sought for in this Writ Petition and accordingly, the Writ Petition is allowed. The Preliminary Notification dated 12.12.2006 (Annexure-A) passed by respondent No.2, in so far as the land in question is concerned, is hereby quashed.

SD/-
